name: Contra Costa County Library Teen Volunteers
city: Contra Costa County, CA (Richmond, Concord, Pleasant Hill and other branches)
what_you_do: Teen roles include Summer Read volunteer, Computer Docent and Homework Help.
grades: Entering 8th grade or above (Summer Read); age 16+ for other roles
who_can_apply: Summer Read: entering 8th grade or above, with parent consent. Computer Docent and Homework Help: age 16 or older.
duration: Summer Read 1 to 2 hours a week; Computer Docents at least 2 hours a week
deadline_text: Summer Read recruiting starts in April. Some libraries take volunteers on a limited basis.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer interest form on ccclib.org/volunteer. You may be called for an interview. Forms stay on file for six months.
notes: Contact your branch to see if it is taking volunteers now.
